title: fix(cli): a production serve with no storage says so before any plugin starts, and refuses when its auth service needs a driver
body:
Fixes #23573
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

A production `os serve` of a host config (one whose `plugins` hold plugin instances) with no recognized `OS_DATABASE_URL`, no `--dev` and no plugin named like a driver declared no default datasource at the storage step, and said nothing. The boot then died in `AuthPlugin.start()` with `No driver available for object 'sys_organization'`, after an objectql ERROR whose fix sends the operator to "check the datasource behind sys_metadata", which nobody declared.

This is the seat's option A (claim `6185741820`): a guard at the end of kernel Phase 1.

- **`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, storage step (step 2).** Only records `productionResolvedNoStorage` when `resolveStorageDefinition` answers `null`. It refuses nothing.
- **`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, composition tail.** One CLI plugin, `com.objectstack.cli.no-storage-boot-guard`, registered only when that flag is set, and registered LAST: after `com.objectstack.cli.seed-settlement-announcer`, immediately before `runtime.start()`. Its `init()` reads `ctx.getServices()` once, the same map ObjectQL adopts `driver.*` services from at its start, plus the engine's `getDefaultDriverName()` for a driver registered straight on the engine.
  - A driver is present: silent.
  - No driver, the `auth` service is registered, and `tenancy.posture` is `single`: the boot is refused before any `start()`, exit 1, through serve's existing refusal idiom (the artifact gate's: `restoreOutput()`, a red block, a thrown `Refusing to boot: …` that the fatal handler prints). It names three fixes: set `OS_DATABASE_URL`, mount a storage driver in the stack's `plugins` (for example `new DriverPlugin(driver)`), or run with `--dev`.
  - No driver otherwise: one `⚠ No storage: …` line naming the same fixes, worded as of the end of plugin init, and the boot goes on.
- **`packages/cli/test/serve-no-storage-boot-guard.integration.test.ts`.** Five production boots of the built CLI, one per cause (below).
- **`scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`.** The pin spawns `bin/run.js`, so it joins that gate's pinned built-entrypoint population, by name, the way the gate asks (one roster entry, "seven" becomes "eight").
- **`.changeset/23573-serve-no-storage-loud.md`.** `@objectstack/cli` patch, with the before and after.

⛔ Not touched: the `5c` blocks (PR #23469, now on `main` as `5c-ter`), `packages/objectql`, `plugin-auth`, `packages/core`, the drivers, `content/docs/**`.

## Measured shapes

Production posture: `node packages/cli/bin/run.js serve objectstack.config.ts -p PORT` on the built CLI, `NODE_ENV`, `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `DATABASE_URL` and `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER` unset, `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`. Fixtures are throwaway `defineStack` host configs with one object. "Before" is base `9f81260487` unless marked (8d05456cbe = the measurement report `6184721596`). "After" is this branch, re-measured on the merged head `650e28a731` for the rows marked *.

| Shape | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| R1 `examples/app-showcase`, auth secret | exit 1, `sys_organization` (8d05456cbe) | refused, exit 1; neither downstream line |
| R2* host fixture, auth secret | exit 1, `sys_organization` | refused, exit 1; fixture plugin `init` ran, `start` never did |
| R3* host fixture, no secret | exit 1 at `package-service` start (8d05456cbe) | the line, then the same `package-service` failure |
| R4 declared `default` datasource (`autoConnect`), auth secret | exit 1, `sys_organization` | refused |
| R8 stack `AuthPlugin`, a stack plugin registers a driver on the engine in `start()` | exit 1 (8d05456cbe) | refused |
| R8b a stack plugin registers `driver.*` in `start()`, listed before a stack `ObjectQLPlugin` and `AuthPlugin` | exit 1, `sys_organization` | refused |
| R8c the same, registering on the engine | exit 1, "database refused" (`no such table`) | refused |
| R9* plugin `com.acme.store` (no driver-like name) registers `driver.*` in `init()`, auth secret | boots, health 200 | boots, silent |
| R9e a plugin registers on the engine in `init()`, auth secret | boots | boots, silent |
| R10* `--no-server --preset minimal`, no secret | boots DEGRADED (8d05456cbe) | the line before any `start()`, then boots |
| R11* a module `onEnable` registers a driver (`ctx.drivers.register`), no secret | boots | the line, then boots |
| R20c* stack `AuthPlugin({ membershipPolicy })` + `OrganizationsPlugin`, `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group`, `--no-server --preset minimal`, no driver anywhere | boots, DEGRADED: job | the line, then boots |
| R12* `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:ctl.db`, auth secret | boots (8d05456cbe) | boots, silent |
| R13* `--dev`, auth secret | boots (8d05456cbe) | boots, silent |

A refused boot wrote nothing to disk before the refusal: no `.objectstack/` in the fixture or in `examples/app-showcase`, and an empty `OS_HOME`. Its Phase-1 side effects are two `init()` log lines (the SDUI-manifest notice, the `StorageServicePlugin` local-driver warning).

## The ordering the guard rests on, verified

- `resolvePluginOrder` (`packages/core/src/plugin-order.ts`) is a DFS over insertion order. The guard is inserted last and nothing declares it as a dependency, so its `init()` is the last `init()` and precedes every `start()`. Measured: on R2 the fixture plugin's `init` marker is on the stream and its `start` marker is not; on R9 a driver registered in another plugin's `init()` is seen.
- No driver registered in a `start()` reaches `AuthPlugin.start()` in time. The flag needs declared objects, so step 3 composes `AppPlugin`, whose `optionalDependencies` are `com.objectstack.engine.objectql`, `com.objectstack.auth` and `com.objectstack.auth.identity-objects`. That hoists ObjectQL and auth ahead of every stack plugin. `ObjectQLPlugin` declares no dependencies. Measured: R8, R8b and R8c fail before this change.
- R11's `onEnable` driver registers during `AppPlugin.start()`, after the guard's `init()`. No auth is composed there, so it gets the line and boots.

## Two departures from the dispatch, both measured

- **The refusal predicate is `auth` registered AND `tenancy.posture === 'single'`, not `auth` registered alone.** R20c registers the `auth` service, has no driver anywhere, and boots today: `AuthPlugin.start()` reads `sys_organization` only under the `single` posture (`auth-plugin.ts`, `start()`). Refusing on `auth` alone would refuse a configuration that boots, which the claim forbids. The tenancy service's `posture` is the posture in force (a degraded walled request reads `single`), which is exactly the condition `AuthPlugin.start()` branches on.
- **The datasource fix is spelled "mount a storage driver in the stack's plugins (e.g. `new DriverPlugin(driver)`)", not "declare a datasource".** R4 declares a `default` datasource with `autoConnect` and still fails: a config-declared datasource connects in `AppPlugin.start()`, after `AuthPlugin.start()`. Telling an R4 operator to declare a datasource would send them to the thing they already did.

## Tests

All on the final head `650e28a731` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `7c6b7f4a35`), after a rebuild of the CLI's dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/cli...'`, 62 tasks, exit 0).

- **The pin and its eight neighbours** (the diff adds an integration-tier file, so that tier is run here for these files; the rest of it is CI's): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `test/serve-no-storage-boot-guard.integration.test.ts` plus `serve-config-boot-flat-docs`, `serve-config-boot-residual`, `serve-host-config-metadata-door`, `serve-migrate-exit-schema-parity`, `serve-view-container-read` (`.integration`), `serve-package-declared-capabilities`, `serve-runtime-state-project-key` and `serve-host-config`: `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 61 passed (61)`. The pin alone, three runs: 23.58 s, 24.37 s, 24.68 s.
- **The unit layer:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 290 passed (290)`, `Tests 4323 passed (4323)`.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`, exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`; the pin is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program, counted with `--listFilesOnly`).
- **Ablation of the refusal** (committed fix first; `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with its EXIT/INT/TERM restore). Mutation: the refusal's condition prefixed with `false &&`, anchor x1 to x0, blob `c016f7b009c1` to `139994049e2d`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, then `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/cli` found the marker in 1 built file. The pin: `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed`; the refusal leg failed on `no refusal was printed`, and the boot it read printed `[ObjectQL] No driver available for object 'sys_organization'` and `ERROR sys_metadata could NOT be read at boot`. Restore: blob back to `c016f7b009c1` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuild, preflight `--absent` (absent from all 632 built files, tree clean against HEAD); the pin `Tests 5 passed (5)`. Measured before the merge with `main`, which touches no line of this diff.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `650e28a731`: 86 commands (the edit to `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` brings 19 of them). All 86 run, each exit code recorded before any pipe: all 86 exit 0. `--ran`: `86 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)`.
- The edited gate's own suite: `node scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs --self-test` (152 cases pass) and its audit (`all 179 spawn call(s) declare their child's env`), both exit 0; `node scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs` and its `--self-test`, which name that script, exit 0.
- Read for this change though not derived: `pnpm check:startup-registry-verdict` exit 0 (`none recording a verdict the boot can contradict`), `pnpm check:init-service-contract` exit 0.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the three changed code files, exit 0, 0 messages. The narrowing holds because (1) the root `lint` is `eslint . --no-inline-config`, the same flags; (2) `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting for any file (its own note: no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so a file's verdict depends on that file alone; (3) `--print-config` resolves active rules for each of the three files (5, 5 and 2), so none of them is ignored. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- CI check-runs: not yet read; they start when this PR opens.

## Acceptance notes

- The `⚠ No storage:` line is worded as of the end of plugin init ("… so objects have no store unless a plugin registers one when it starts"), not as a verdict, because a `start()` can still register a driver (R11). AGENTS.md "Startup registry reads" is the rule; `pnpm check:startup-registry-verdict` is green.
- The pin is named `.integration.test.ts`, not `.e2e.test.ts`: the `.e2e` name moves a file to the nightly run on `main` (`OS_TEST_TIERS`), and this pin guards a boot order any `serve.ts` edit can break. Its declared budget is 40 s (`// test-budget:` header, class "spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture"): the slower of two local runs, 24.4 s on a shared container, x 1.25, rounded up. No CI reading exists yet; the first refresh that reads one re-measures it.
- R3 (no auth secret, default preset) still dies at `package-service` start. It now prints the line with the fixes first. Refusing it was not in the ruling.
- Out-of-scope findings are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #23573 for the seat to file or route; none is fixed here.
